enabled.description: Enable or disable the lvmlockd daemon on system startup.

lockdir.description: Path to the lock directory used for lockspace coordination files.

max_lockspaces.description: Maximum number of lockspaces the daemon will manage.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle lock operations.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the lvmlockd daemon.

lockspaces.description: List of lockspaces to configure. Each defines a lockspace (e.g., for clustered LVM volumes).

name.description: Name of the lockspace (e.g., 'vgname' for a volume group).

lock_type.description: Lock backend type: 'dlm' (Distributed Lock Manager) or 'sanlock'.

path.description: Path to the metadata device or file (required for 'sanlock').

offset.description: Byte offset within the metadata device/file for sanlock.

cluster_name.description: Name of the DLM cluster (optional; defaults to system cluster name).

auto_create.description: Automatically create this lockspace when lvmlockd starts.

pacemaker_enabled.description: Enable coordination with Pacemaker cluster manager.

pacemaker_socket_path.description: Unix socket path to communicate with Pacemaker's resource manager.
